name: Five in a Row
description: Gravity-drop connection game. Two players alternate dropping discs into columns; discs fall to the lowest empty slot. First to connect N in a row in any allowed direction wins; board fills with no winner = draw. Fully configurable in pre-match: board width and height (default 10×7), the required line length (default 5), and whether diagonals count (default yes). The 10×7 / connect-5 default is a deliberately wider board than a classic 7×6 four-in-a-row grid — bigger search space, less risk of forced wins. Set `connect_n=4` on a 7×6 board for the classic four-in-a-row game; set `connect_n=3` on a 5×5 board with no diagonals for stacked tic-tac-toe.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Players alternate dropping discs. White moves first.

entity_types.name: ConnectFivePlayer
entity_types.description: A Connect Five player. Reads the board, picks which column to drop into.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Side: 'white' (moves first) or 'black'. Assigned by seat order.

properties.name: discs_played
properties.description: Total discs this player has dropped so far.

properties.name: playing_style
properties.description: 0 = highly defensive, blocks every threat; 1 = aggressive, prioritizes building own lines.

properties.name: calculation_depth
properties.description: How many moves ahead the player tends to consider.

actions.name: drop_disc
actions.description: Drop one of your discs into a column. REQUIRED parameter `column` (integer, 1-indexed). The disc falls to the lowest empty row in that column. `column` MUST appear in `legal_columns` from your perception — full columns are illegal. No target_id; the action is column-only.

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Builder
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Focuses on building own threats — stacks and extends own lines aggressively. Will sometimes allow an opponent's near-win if their own threat is more imminent.

agent_archetypes.name: Defensive Blocker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Prioritizes blocking the opponent's threats — never lets a 3-in-a-row stand undisturbed. Slow to build own attacks, very hard to beat.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Tactician
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Adapts to the board state — builds when ahead in tempo, blocks when behind. Solid all-rounder.

agent_archetypes.name: Forking Specialist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Looks for forks — board positions creating two threats at once that the opponent can't block simultaneously. Plays for the long combination.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Connect Five is strictly 2 players (one White, one Black).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.board_cols
runtime_parameters.label: Board width (columns)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of columns. Classic Connect Four is 7; default 10 gives more room and reduces forced wins.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.board_rows
runtime_parameters.label: Board height (rows)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of rows. Classic Connect Four is 6; default 7 adds one extra row for the wider 10-column board.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.connect_n
runtime_parameters.label: Connect-N (in a row to win)
runtime_parameters.description: How many in a row are needed to win. Default 5 (Connect Five); set to 4 for classic Connect Four, or 3 for a stacked tic-tac-toe.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.allow_diagonals
runtime_parameters.label: Diagonals count toward wins
runtime_parameters.description: If ON (default), lines in any of 8 directions (horizontal, vertical, both diagonals) count. If OFF, only horizontal and vertical lines win — a meaner game.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'tournament final' or 'casual blitz'.

termination_conditions.name: connect_n_win
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player connects N in a row.

termination_conditions.name: resignation
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player resigns.

termination_conditions.name: draw
termination_conditions.description: End the game on a board-full draw.
